result.instructions: Read-only ARCHMELD evidence access. Start with archmeld_status or archmeld_brief. Indexing is a CLI step (`archmeld init`); this process never creates a snapshot. Workflow: status -> brief/review -> query/context -> source. Candidate relations are not resolved calls, and review never executes tests.

tools.description: Inspect a registered project, frozen snapshot, job, or record by authorized ID. No filesystem traversal.
tools.name: archmeld_inspect
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.description: Use when you need symbols, callers, dependencies or a bounded path/impact traversal. Results carry basis, resolution and evidence; candidate edges are not resolved calls.
tools.name: archmeld_query
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.description: Use when you need a bounded, snapshot-bound evidence pack for a task. Returns selected entities, source snippets, claims, omissions and a resume cursor.
tools.name: archmeld_context
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.description: Use when you need the exact bytes of an entity anchor from the snapshot. Never reads an arbitrary filesystem path.
tools.name: archmeld_source
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.description: Call this first when the project, snapshot or working-tree state is unknown. Reports registered projects, latest snapshots, counts, languages and read-only freshness. Creates no snapshot and records no drift.
tools.name: archmeld_status
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.description: Use when the user asks to summarize a project, review a change, report the evidence-bound cognition map, or decide what to inspect next. Returns a one-screen read-only brief with counts, findings, unknowns and next actions, plus a markdown content item a human or agent can read directly. Candidate relations are not resolved calls; review never executes tests.
tools.name: archmeld_brief
tools.x-authority: read-only composition of status and static workspace review; the workspace root comes only from the registered project

tools.description: Use when the user asks what changed or whether a workspace is safe to edit. Statically reviews the registered workspace against a frozen snapshot; no build, test or runtime command is executed and verification is not_run.
tools.name: archmeld_review
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; the workspace root comes only from the registered project, never a caller path

tools.description: Report the tools and operations this process can actually execute, and distinguish external-grant requirements from unimplemented declarations. Read-only; grants nothing.
tools.name: archmeld_capabilities
